description: Describes a variable the scripts of a webhook integration derive from a call, such as a claim of a token, the gateway's own credential, a request header or a body field.

description.description: A longer explanation of the variable, for when the short description is not enough, for example with links to the vendor's documentation.
description.title: description

name.description: The name of the variable. It must be the key the variable is listed under, start with an alphanumeric character and contain neither = nor spaces. A name may use * to match any run of characters, for variables whose exact name is the user's choice, such as a header name. Header variables are named header:<lowercased name>, and variables whose values the vendor did not verify are prefixed unverified:, since any client can set them.
name.title: name

shortDescription.description: What the variable is, in one sentence, including whether the vendor verified it.
shortDescription.title: shortDescription

title: WebhookIntegrationVariable
